hotspots.title: Reception
hotspots.description: The reception area is one of the first points of contact for visitors entering the campus. It provides a welcoming space where students and visitors can receive assistance and information.

hotspots.title: Gamma Classroom
hotspots.description: Gamma Classroom provides students with a dedicated environment for lectures, discussions and other academic activities.

hotspots.title: Outside Main Entrance
hotspots.description: Welcome to Belgium Campus iTversity Kempton Park. The main entrance provides visitors and prospective students with their first view of the campus and serves as the starting point of the immersive campus tour.

hotspots.title: Delta Classroom
hotspots.description: Delta Classroom is one of the teaching spaces on the Kempton Park campus and is used for lectures and classroom-based academic activities.

hotspots.title: Omega Classroom
hotspots.description: Omega Classroom is an academic teaching area where students can attend lectures and participate in classroom activities.

hotspots.title: Lecture Room / Auditorium
hotspots.description: The auditorium is a larger learning and presentation space used for lectures, presentations and other campus activities.

hotspots.title: Library & Study Room
hotspots.description: The library and study area provide students with a quieter environment for studying, completing academic work and preparing for assessments.

hotspots.title: Cafeteria
hotspots.description: The cafeteria provides students with a place to take breaks, eat and socialize between academic activities.

hotspots.title: Cafeteria Tuckshop
hotspots.description: The tuckshop forms part of the cafeteria area and provides a convenient facility for students during breaks and throughout the campus day.

hotspots.title: Campus Parking Area
hotspots.description: The campus parking area provides designated parking for students, staff and visitors and provides access to the main campus area.
